body: After so many disappointments over the years with these types of apps, I was really skeptical at first… but honestly, they’re doing a great job! author: TechnoToken3000

title: Could be better
body:
I fist intended to use this app for my daily routines & get things a bit more organized. However after many days using Tiimo I am seeing several issues in the way notifications & automations are done.

None of my notifications are working although they all have been approved. I am a Morning Routine which doesn’t display on my screen although I specified the time frame for it. 

Really nice widgets and Live Activity thing but I was expecting something automatic that would have started at the moment I wanted. Instead, I need to open the app every morning to make it work. Sometimes when I open it, Tiimo doesn’t show any Routine starting- I have to close the app, reopen it or sometimes I need to edit my Routine so it appears as “being tracked”. I don’t like this.

Another big issue I face is the connectivity with my Apple Watch. When I have an ongoing Routine and want to open in on my Watch, 8 times out of 10 I see a screen saying that I don’t have anything running. When I refresh / resync through the Watch app, it shows a Routine I can’t even update in real time. E.g this morning I wanted to complete the 2 first steps of it from my Watch but didn’t work, I wasn’t able to select the task although the screen clearly shows that it could be possible this way. 

Great design & stuff but not optimized yet.
